text:
alex: Quick sync 18h out. Need: final changelog link, prod docs URL, confirmed announce time, and the canonical UTM string for lead form. Also trying to lock A/B headline for social.
sam: Changelog published on main: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/abc123. Short bullet list attached for copy. Prod docs will be https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-25 once CDN invalidation completes (ETA +30m).
karim: Ops: suggested rollout plan: 10:00 PT smoke (10% traffic), 10:10 PT ramp to 50%, 10:30 PT full. Rollback trigger: error rate >1% for 5m or P95 latency +250ms over baseline.
isabel: For A/B headline testing: Option A "Faster LLM inference, lower cost" Option B "Ship LLM features with predictable latency". Which maps better to the benchmark narrative?
alex: I prefer B for landing, A for tweets. Marketing will run A/B on social only.
tess: Lead form URL will be /launch-contact. Propose UTM: utm_source=announce&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=mar25_launch. Confirm?
karim: Confirmed. Make sure form includes hidden field "release_tag=mar25" so routing to AE queue works.
sam: Changelog snippet for comms: "- KV cache eviction fixes to reduce tail latency
- Adaptive batching: ~12-18% token-cost savings on short prompts
- Private (on-prem) KMS support added (beta)" Use that verbatim.
isabel: Webinar CTA will go live 10:15 PT. Promo schedule: email at 10:05 PT, social at 10:15 and 10:30. Live webinar 11:00 PT.
alex: Marketing set publish for 10:10 PT to let first smoke complete. Social primary post at +5m. Webinar CTA inclusion confirmed.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary job started at 2026-03-25T17:00:00Z run/556 status=queued -> running. Staged rollouts enabled.
karim: Note: routing policy will prefer hosted endpoints in us-west for the first wave, fall back to dedicated after ramp. Also enable short-seq quantization profile for canary only.
isabel: Landing page copy updated with benchmark callout (p95 latency numbers) but we need exact numbers to include. Sam can you paste final benchmark line?
sam: Quick numbers from bench run: baseline p95 down 22% on e2e for short prompts (50-100 tokens), median latency improved 12%. Use "~22% p95 improvement on short prompts" in marketing copy.
tess: I've wired the lead form to mark source=mar25_launch and route to Growth AE pool. Will update CRM mappings after prod docs link is live.
alex: Can someone drop the prod docs URL here when CDN is live so I can swap staging links in the PR?
sam: CDN is live. Prod docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-25 (final).
isabel: Perfect. I'm locking the primary social copy and final hero headline. I'll post variants to the campaign doc.
karim: Ops will keep enhanced tracing on for 2 hours post-launch. I'll be on standby.
alex: Great. Final checklist: changelog link (sam) ✅ docs prod URL ✅ canary windows (karim) ✅ UTMs + lead routing (tess) ✅ social A/B plan (isabel) ✅ webinar slot & CTA (isabel) ✅
isabel: I'll run a 10m preflight at 09:50 PT with product and ops.
alex: Thanks team. If anything urgent, update this thread. :rocket:
__notes: Marketing-engineering pre-release alignment. Single-thread Slack style. Short messages, bot status, UTMs and benchmark numbers included.
